card.name: Small words before Midwestern place names
card.fires_on: Small linking words like in, the, of, at in old local-history prose, right where a US Midwest place name (state, county, river, railroad) is expected next.

modes.label: Preposition before a place
modes.description: in, of, or at just before a county, state, or city name in settler history.

modes.label: The before a regional name
modes.description: the before a river, railroad, or geographic feature in the Midwest.
modes.example: on the lines of<< the>> Pere Marquette railroad

card.writes: It pushes Midwestern place names like Indiana, Illinois, Chicago and Mississippi, and pushes down mountain and Rocky or Colorado names.
card.plain: It fires on little words in old local histories just before a Midwestern state or town name is expected.
